name: zmath_camera_stage_inverse_rotation
description: zMath_Camera_StageInverseRotation stages camera scratch matrices by copying the world matrix, negating camera-space axes, transposing the rotation into CameraScratchB, and transforming the negated position.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zMath camera helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x473e60 validates copying the 4x3 world matrix into CameraScratchA, sign-bit negation of the Y and Z basis rows, copying into CameraScratchB, transposing the staged rotation basis, sign-bit negation of translation, transforming that negated translation by the staged rotation, and return.
The native zMath projection/setup smoke verifies CameraScratchA basis negation and CameraScratchB transposed rotation plus transformed negated position values.
